title: Did you just update to Wi-Fi only?!
content:
I don’t know whether this is a bug or a new “feature” but either way, it sucks. This game is pretty much a constant companion on my commutes in the subway. To my surprise, I’m now blocked from doing so with a “Connection Problem” message. Thinking it was an update issue, I updated to the latest version when I next connected to WiFi and everything’s fine. I went to mobile data, and I’m locked out. 

Changing your game app to only work with a WiFi connection is quite frankly a questionable decision. I’m pretty sure I’m not the only person who uses this without WiFi/ mobile data. If it’s to force users to watch ads, even more diabolical and in bad taste. 

I’ll give the benefit of the doubt. But it’s a way to force users to view ads, you’re going to lose users. This direction is frankly more irritating because there’s no option to pay for an ad-free version. Who thought that this was a good idea?!

Thanks. I hope you take my comment under advisement. 

Sincerely,
A loyal but very irritated and disgruntled user.

content: This game is honestly a joke now. I used to play it all the time and had a high score over 800,000 using pure strategy. I just got a new iPhone and my score got deleted, so I had to start over. That’s when I noticed how bad the updates messed up the app. It doesn’t even feel like a puzzle game anymore, just an ad trap.The new algorithm feels totally rigged. It watches your board and intentionally gives you the worst possible shapes. Sometimes you get 3 pieces at the exact same time that literally cannot fit anywhere on the screen together. There’s physically no way to play them, and it’s not even fun. Getting stuck at 13k or 30k because the game is literally cheating you takes all the skill out of it.They obviously ruined a great game just to force people to watch ads and click "revive" for an extra turn. I hope the ad revenue was worth ruining the game for everyone who actually liked it. Don't even bother downloading this version. If you want the actual fair game, get the Apple Arcade version (Block Blast!+) instead because it’s completely ad-free and actually lets you play.
